observed: Root OP uses threadId; replies use postId; id is not post identity.
Thread .net/.org endpoints returned identical bytes, directly without a redirect.
Thread 200 supplied Last-Modified; conditional If-Modified-Since produced 304.
Known-board catalog is a flat array. fileCount counts reply files, not all attachments.
Original paths use same-origin /.media/<flat-name>; thumb names may have no extension.
Exact requested missing thread endpoint returned 404.
documentedOnly: Multiple files per post are documented; the bounded live sample did not demonstrate multifile.
localPolicy: Canonical .net is a local choice, not a claim about server redirects.
Only .org is admitted as an alias; no .gg, eu.* or www.
Board identities are case-preserving ASCII letters/digits/underscore; no merged + boards.
Always Active: archived/end status has not been verified.
Catalog IsComplete false; no page/cursor request; no global board discovery or previews.
Synthetic fixtures use invented content and sizes, not downloaded image bytes.
unknown: Deployed Endchan revision and deployed fork provenance.
Archived and explicit post/media deletion semantics.
Full source health and original-media availability.
provenance: Implementation adapted from this repository Kohlchan.cs; no upstream implementation copied. Operator-linked documentation was consulted as protocol evidence only.
limits: Eight bounded public GETs, no cookie/login/POST/original/thumbnail request, no redirect followed, no retries, no truncation.
